title: Ask it anything. Watch what it builds.
caption:
OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 and Intelligent UI in ChatGPT for everyone.

Intelligent UI delivers visual, interactive answers instead of plain text.
It makes complex topics easier to follow and builds task tools on the spot.
Both features are now available to all ChatGPT users.
